title: Vendedor(a) Intermitente | ZARA
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Vendedor(a) Intermitente | ZARA em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

A loja é ritmo, decisão e equipe.  É onde as coisas acontecem, onde se vive a moda e onde cada pessoa contribui. Aqui, seu papel é muito mais do que atender. Você observa, da ideias, cuida do produto e do espaço. Você está lá para os clientes que entram e também para a equipe que trabalha com você. Você fará parte de uma equipe curiosa e criativa, que busca fazer as coisas à sua maneira e se move com entusiasmo até conseguir. Procuramos pessoas que gostem do ritmo, da moda e que transformem o dia a dia a partir do que são. Oferecemos um salário competitivo. Treinamento desde o primeiro dia e oportunidades reais de crescimento. Aqui você encontrará o espaço e a equipe para continuar crescendo com sua própria visão. Oferecemos um ambiente onde aprender faz parte do dia a dia e onde há espaço para contribuir, errar e evoluir. Este pode ser o início da sua história conosco. Caso busque por flexibilidade de horário e/ou busque uma posição de porta de entrada freelance, essa vaga é para você! Nosso contrato de trabalho intermitente, funciona da seguinte forma:  O contrato é CLT por tempo indeterminado, atuando em loja sempre que houver uma convocação. Convocação : Duram um período de 15 dias, havendo a possibilidade de renovação por mais 15 dias, que funciona de forma intermitente, de acordo com a necessidade da loja. Renovação : Ocorrem a cada 15 dias. Responsabilidades e atribuições:  Atendimento ao cliente; Organização de produtos e loja; Atendimento no provador.  Caso você venha fazer parte do nosso time, terá direito à:  Salário fixo hora, comissão, vale Transporte, vale refeição, férias e 13º salário proporcionais. Tem interesse em conhecer mais sobre esse modelo de contratação? Faça seu cadastro e traga sua energia para o nosso time!

title: Supervisor de recrutamento e seleção
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Supervisor de recrutamento e seleção em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Sua nova empresa  Faça parte de uma grande líder global em soluções logísticas, reconhecida por sua robustez operacional, cultura de melhoria contínua e forte foco em segurança, eficiência e excelência na jornada do cliente. A companhia possui atuação nacional e internacional, sendo referência em inovação e qualidade na gestão de transportes, operações complexas e serviços logísticos integrados. Sua nova posição  Como Supervisor(a) de Recrutamento & Seleção de alto volume , você será peça-chave na consolidação da nova estrutura centralizada de Talent Acquisition, atuando diretamente no desenho, gestão e operação do processo de R&S de alto volume em âmbito nacional. Reportando-se à alta liderança da área, você apoiará todas as regiões na condução de processos seletivos críticos e será responsável por liderar coordenadoras regionais, garantindo fluidez operacional, alinhamento estratégico e alta performance da equipe. Além de atuar estrategicamente, esta posição exige forte capacidade de execução e presença ativa na rotina – sendo fundamental colocar a mão na massa sempre que necessário. A área está em pleno processo de transição: atualmente são cerca de 85 profissionais de R&S, e você assumirá a liderança direta e indireta de aproximadamente 30 pessoas, com grande potencial de crescimento futuro para uma posição gerencial. Principais responsabilidades  Conduzir e liderar a operação de Recrutamento & Seleção de alto volume. Garantir o cumprimento e evolução dos principais indicadores de performance: Volume de vagas Tempo médio de fechamento Qualidade da base e aderência de perfis Indicadores de diversidade Taxa de desistência Controle e gestão do faturamento das consultorias de R&S Atuação próxima aos clientes internos, com postura madura, clara e orientada à solução. Gestão e desenvolvimento das coordenadoras regionais de R&S. Negociação e relacionamento com fornecedores, incluindo prazos, processos e faturamento. Apoio estratégico na transição do modelo descentralizado para a célula corporativa.  O que precisa para ser bem-sucedido  Buscamos uma profissional com sólida experiência em recrutamento de alto volume , forte capacidade de gestão de times e vivência em ambientes de grande escala. Requisitos essenciais:  Experiência robusta em operações de R&S com grande volume de vagas. Vivência em empresas ou consultorias com demanda massiva (alto volume efetivo e temporário). Experiencia fazendo gestão de fornecedores (Consultorias) Gestão de equipes grandes e distribuídas. Inglês necessário. Conhecimento em ferramentas de recrutamento (LinkedIn, InfoJobs, Catho). Experiência com múltiplas áreas funcionais e operações de larga escala.  O que você obterá em troca  A oportunidade de liderar uma operação estratégica de R&S em plena transformação, com alta exposição às principais lideranças da companhia e impacto direto na construção do novo modelo de Talent Acquisition. Você atuará em um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico, com grande espaço para melhorias e desenvolvimento profissional, além de potencial real de evolução para uma futura posição gerencial. O que precisa fazer agora  Se estiver interessada nesta posição, clique em “Aplicar-se agora”  para enviar seu CV atualizado ou entre em contato conosco para mais informações.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:

About the Team   SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.  Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.  Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.  What You Will Do   Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.   Lead cross-team initiatives:   Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.   Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.   Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.   Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.   Drive roadmap and execution:  Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.   Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).   Establish engineering excellence:   Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.   Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.   Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.   Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.   Champion security and compliance by design:   Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.   Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.   Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.   Partner with the Architects:  Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.   Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.   Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.   Own delivery outcomes:  Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.   Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.   Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.   Operate a healthy on-call:  High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).   Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.   Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.   Initiatives You Will Lead:   Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.   AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.   Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).   Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.   Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.   Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.   Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.   Success Metrics   Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.   Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.   Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.   Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.   Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.   SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).   What You Will Bring   Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.   Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.   Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.   Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.   Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.   Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.   Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).   Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.   What You’ll Need   Advanced skills in English   Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.   Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).   Database performance engineering and query optimization.   Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.   FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).   How We Work   Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.   Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.   Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.   Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.   Tech Environment   Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).  Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).  Azure DevOps for CI/CD.  CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).  Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.  Caches: Redis.  Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.  Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.  Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. title: Product Owner
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Product Owner em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨ Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas.  Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real.  Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):  Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução.  Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:  1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)  Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica  Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)  Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia.  Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)  Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total.  Diferencial Competitivo  IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia.  PARA ISSO, OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ TRABALHAR CONOSCO:   01) Salário: A combinar (Enviar pretensão salarial) 02 Segunda a Sexta 03) Horário: 08h às 17h 04) Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP 05) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) 06) Regime de contratação: CLT 07) Plano de carreira 08) Cesta básica R$250,00 09) Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia 10) Vale transporte c/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 11) Benefícios de VR, Cesta e Auxilio combustível, pagos através de um cartão unificado e flexível, operadora pela Sólides, para utilização na modalidade de crédito, bandeira Mastercard e que é aceito em uma infinidade de estabelecimentos 12) Convênio Farmácia,que conta com ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento 13) Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês 14) Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna 15) Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping 16) Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido, pago mensalmente diretamente à administração  Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

QUALIFICAÇÕES   Ensino Superior Completo em Direito, Contabilidade, Administração de Empresas ou afins;  Experiência comimpostos impostos diretos (IRPJ, CSLL) e indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS);  Experiência comPlanejamento Tributário;  Experiência comobrigações fiscais e acessórias (SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DIRB, REINF/DCTF WEB e PERDCOMP);  Experiência comlegislações tributárias;  Experiência em interface com diversas áreas;  Experiência commelhoria de processos e sistemas;  Excel intermediário.   Desejável: Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito Tributário, Gestão Tributária, Planejamento Tributário ou áreas correlatas;  Conhecimento emSAP, TaxOne ou outro ERP.   Nós, da ORÍGEO, acreditamos que um time com diversidade constrói grandes histórias. Por isso, se você é uma Pessoa com Deficiência e se identificou com essa vaga, participe do nosso processo seletivo!

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Site Reliability Engineering Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Team    SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.    Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.   Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.    What You Will Do     Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.     Lead cross-team initiatives:     Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.     Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.     Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.     Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.     Drive roadmap and execution:    Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.     Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).     Establish engineering excellence:     Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.     Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.     Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.     Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.     Champion security and compliance by design:     Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.     Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.     Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.     Partner with the Architects:    Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.     Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.     Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.     Own delivery outcomes:    Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.     Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.     Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.     Operate a healthy on-call:    High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).     Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.     Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.     Initiatives You Will Lead:     Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.     AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.     Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).     Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.     Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.     Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.     Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.     Success Metrics     Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.     Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.     Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.     Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.     Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.     SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).     What You Will Bring     Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.     Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.     Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.     Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.     Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.     Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.     Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).     Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.     What You’ll Need     Advanced skills in English      Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.     Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).     Database performance engineering and query optimization.     Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.     FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).     How We Work     Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.     Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.     Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.     Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.     Tech Environment     Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).    Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).    Azure DevOps for CI/CD.    CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).    Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.    Caches: Redis.    Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.    Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.    Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):    Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:   1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)   Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna.   Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento.   Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.  2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica    Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. GDM   is a global leader in plant genetics, dedicated to transforming agriculture through technological innovation. With a continuous focus on research and development, we bring to market the most advanced and high-performing seed varieties, creating new growth opportunities for our partners and for the future of agribusiness.   Our  DNA    We are passionate about what we do and driven by curiosity. We believe that learning and innovation are the foundation for transforming the future of agriculture. If you are passionate about learning and want to be part of transforming agriculture, GDM is the right place for you!   What will your routine look like working with us?   Globally responsible for developing and deploying advanced AI solutions across GDM’s plant breeding and genomics R&D portfolio to accelerate genetic gain, improve selection accuracy, and shorten breeding cycles.   Integrate phenotypic, genotypic, environmental, and remote sensing datasets into scalable AI architectures.   Implementing new machine learning models as an alternative to traditional methods of genomic selection.   Build agentic AI workflows to automate breeding analytics, model retraining, and decision-support pipelines.     Requirements to participate in the process:    Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy or Agricultural Engineer, with a Master’s and/or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or Plant Breeding   Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and AI, including different algorithms, techniques, and applications   Strong foundation in quantitative genetics and breeding systems.   Implement imputation methods for genotypic data; optimize training sets & genetic diversity for genome-wide selection in a crop breeding   Develop and deploy advanced genomic prediction models (e.g., multi-trait, multi-environment, G×E).   Deploy AI models into production environments with monitoring, reproducibility, and performance tracking.   Proficiency in programming languages used in Machine Learning, such as Python and R. Experience with Machine Learning libraries and frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Keras)  Advanced English   Availability to be based at any GDM location:     Brazil   (Campinas - SP; Passo Fundo - RS; Cambé - PR; Lucas do Rio Verde - MT; Rio Verde - GO; Porto Nacional - TO; Petrolina - PE);   Argentina   (San Isidro - Buenos Aires; Chacabuco - Buenos Aires);   United States   (Westfield - Indiana)   Nice to have:    Portuguese or Spanish     At  GDM   , we believe that diversity strengthens our team and drives innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected.   Our positions are open to all talents, and we encourage applications from people with different perspectives and backgrounds. At GDM, the diversity of ideas and experiences is what drives us forward in the evolution of agriculture.

title: Arquiteto de Software
description:
Empresa está contratando Arquiteto de Software em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

A VMetrix  é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo  Arquiteto de Software  é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix . Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais:  Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma  Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.  Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL  Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.  Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código  Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.  Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria  Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.  Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA  Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.  Requisitos Técnicos:  Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.  Requisitos Desejáveis:  Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.  Processo de Candidatura:  Candidatura:  Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico:  Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão:  Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.  Por que trabalhar na VMetrix  Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix  é o lugar.

Visualization:  Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset:  Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.  Profile Requirements  Solution Architect Mentality:  Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver:  A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices. About the Role  As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains. This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth. What You’ll Do  Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.  What You’ll Bring  Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.  Nice to Have  Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish.  Why Regrow  Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits.   Acerca de Regrow  Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas. Sobre el Rol  Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos. Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR. Qué Harás  Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas. Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.  Qué Aportarás  Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos. Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo. Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial. Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras. Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS. Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas. Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento. Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués. Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular. Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.  Deseable  Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento. Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales. Conocimiento funcional del español.  Por Qué Regrow  Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real. Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica. Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

Responsibilities and Duties  Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360; Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records; Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits); Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components; Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases; Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements; Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs; Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases; Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.     Essential Skills  Experience with Salesforce development; Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns; Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing; Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations; Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks); Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams; Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership; Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.      Highly Desirable Skills  Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation; Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration; Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations; Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations; Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD). Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. Position Overview:   We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients. What You'll Do:   Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction. Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions. Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture. Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies. Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools. Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC). Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices. Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more. Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform. Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline. Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients. Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use. Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.  What We're Looking For:   Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment. At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer. Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security. Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices. Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices. Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services. Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows. Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP). Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Fluency in English, both written and verbal. Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools. Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.  Bonus Points For:   Certifications in more than one cloud provider FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools. Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services. Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews. Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices. Experience in a technology consulting environment. Experience with multiple cloud platforms.  What We Offer:   Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement. Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.  Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team! Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at . description:

Job Summary  The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities   Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.  Required Qualifications & Skills  Technical Experience:  5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.  Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:  Communication:  Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:  Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132 em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Turing:  Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview:  An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead  responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems  used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud  skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities:  Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.  Electrical Engineering Subdomains:  You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.  Required Qualifications:  Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).  Nice-to-Have:  Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.  Evaluation Process:  Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form . Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round . Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para AI Evaluation Engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About FirstIgnite  FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role  We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do  Build evaluation infrastructure:  Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means:  Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop:  Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty:  We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation:  Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation:  Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team:  Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.  Requirements  3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.  Preferred Qualifications  Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.  Why This Role  You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.  This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Product Owner em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

ABOUT US  Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE  We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do  Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.  WHAT IT TAKES  The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.  Key Skills  Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.  Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.  OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
